title: DebianMaintenanceContextV1
description: The 1C.3 maintenance-context report. The 1C.3 RED commit's struct is the *minimal* shape (§17 tri-state + provenance + diagnostics); the 1C.3 GREEN commit extends it with the §26 comprehensive fields (patches, tests, watch, gbp, maintainer scripts, upstream_relationship). The sub-types `Patch`, `Autopkgtest`, `WatchConfig`, `GbpConfig`, `MaintainerScripts`, and `Provenance` are reused from the 1C.2 `DebianSourceReportV1` — they live in the same `report` module and the 1C.3 parser composition re-uses the 1C.2 helpers.

gbp.description: §26 maintenance dimension: gbp / dch configuration presence. Reused from 1C.2's `GbpConfig` type. Always present (the struct's `gbp_conf_present: false` carries the absence signal).

maintainer_scripts.description: §26 maintenance dimension: presence and executable bit of `debian/{preinst, postinst, prerm, postrm}`. Reused from 1C.2's `MaintainerScripts` type.

patches.description: §26 maintenance dimension: applied patches with DEP-3 metadata. Reused from 1C.2's `Patch` type. Empty when `debian/patches/` is absent or `series` is empty.

provenance.description: The candidate's BLAKE3 fingerprint, Git commit, and Git tree; the inspector binary's version. 1C.2's `Provenance` type, reused.

tests.description: §26 maintenance dimension: autopkgtest stanzas from `debian/tests/control`. Reused from 1C.2's `Autopkgtest` type. Empty when the file is absent.

upstream_relationship.description: §26 maintenance dimension: upstream relationship metadata (Upstream-Name, Upstream-Contact, Vcs-Git, Vcs-Browser, Homepage). New in 1C.3.

watch.description: §26 maintenance dimension: `debian/watch` v4 configuration. Reused from 1C.2's `WatchConfig` type. `None` when the file is absent.

Autopkgtest.description: One autopkgtest stanza from `debian/tests/control` (§18 tests group).

command.description: Subsequent tokens on the `Tests:` line (the command to run, when it's not the `debian/tests/<name>` default). `None` when the `Tests:` line is just the test name.

depends.description: The `Depends:` field, split into individual entries. Empty when absent.

features.description: The `Features:` field, split into individual tokens. Empty when absent.

name.description: The `Tests:` field, first token (the test name).

restrictions.description: The `Restrictions:` field, split into individual tokens (e.g. `["rw-build-tree"]`). Empty when absent.

Diagnostic.description: A single failure or informational line from the tool.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable error code, e.g. `E_DEBIAN_DIR_MISSING`. Future tools can match on this without parsing the message.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. The tool does not embed the offending value (a) to keep PII out of the report and (b) so the same diagnostic text can serve any fixture.

path.description: The on-disk path that triggered the diagnostic, when applicable (e.g. `debian/`, `debian/changelog`).

GbpBranchSettings.description: The branch / tag settings from `debian/gbp.conf`'s `[BUILD-DEFAULTS]` section.

GbpConfig.description:
The GBP config inventory (§18 GBP group).

The tool reports presence of `debian/gbp.conf` and `debian/gbp-dch.conf` and, when present, the branch / tag settings from the INI-formatted `[BUILD-DEFAULTS]` / `[DCH]` sections. The `branch_settings` block is a structural mirror of the most-commonly-used keys; it is not a full parse of every gbp.conf key.

branch_settings.description: The branch / tag settings parsed from `gbp.conf`. `None` when `gbp.conf` is absent or has no `[BUILD-DEFAULTS]` section.

MaintainerScripts.description:
The full maintainer-script inventory (§18 maintainer scripts group).

The four canonical scripts are `preinst`/`postinst`/`prerm`/`postrm`. The `triggers` file (a non-executable control file) and "other recognized scripts" (e.g. `postinst-config`, `preinst-base`) are observational — the report captures what is there without claiming anything about what *should* be there.

other_scripts.description: Other recognized scripts in `debian/` (e.g. `preinst-base`, `postinst-config`). Each entry is a `ScriptPresence` keyed by the script's name. Excluded: the four canonical scripts (above), `rules` (covered separately), and the patch series (also covered separately).

triggers.description: `Some` when `debian/triggers` exists. The `triggers` file is a control file (not executable) that declares the package's interest in dpkg triggers.

NamedScript.description: A named maintainer script entry for the `other_scripts` list.

Patch.description: One patch in `debian/patches/series` with its DEP-3 header (§18 patches group).

description.description: The DEP-3 `Description:` header. `None` when the patch file has no DEP-3 header.

last_update.description: The DEP-3 `Last-Update:` header (ISO 8601 date). `None` when absent.

name.description: The patch file name as listed in `series` (e.g. `01-fix-typo.patch`).

Provenance.description:
The provenance block (§18 provenance group).

The candidate fingerprint, Git commit, and Git tree are the candidate's identity (the §18 lines 842-846 requirement). `inspector_version` is the version of the `ironmaint-debian-tool` binary that produced the report, so a downstream consumer can tell which parser version emitted the report.

ScriptPresence.description: One maintainer script's presence + executable bit (§18 maintainer scripts group).

executable.description: `true` when the script file exists and the executable bit is set.

UpstreamRelationship.description:
The upstream-relationship metadata block (§26 upstream relationship group; 1C.3's only new sub-type).

Carries the raw `Option<String>` fields from `debian/copyright` (Upstream-Name, Upstream-Contact, Source) and `debian/control` (Vcs-Git, Vcs-Browser, Homepage). The `team_maintained: bool` classification (§26 "Team maintained" bullet) is intentionally deferred to a future PR — the spec does not define the heuristic and committing to one prematurely risks rework.

upstream_contact.description: The DEP-5 `Upstream-Contact:` field from `debian/copyright`. `None` when absent.

upstream_name.description: The DEP-5 `Upstream-Name:` field from `debian/copyright`. `None` when absent.

upstream_url.description: The DEP-5 `Source:` field from `debian/copyright` (the canonical upstream URL for the Files stanzas that follow). `None` when absent.

oneOf.description: At least one §17 check failed (mismatched name, mismatched version, unparsable `debian/control`, unparsable `debian/changelog`, missing `debian/`, unidentifiable source format, unparsable mandatory metadata). Diagnostics list the specific failure.

The tool could not establish the fact at all: the workspace path is unreadable, an IO error occurred, a parser binary is missing. The §17 rule "parser binary missing → InfrastructureError" lives here.

WatchConfig.description:
The parsed `debian/watch` file (§18 watch group).

The Debian watch file is a small RFC 822-ish grammar: `version=N\n<url-pattern>` with optional `pgpsigurlmangle=` and `opts=...` directives. The tool captures the version, the URL pattern, and any PGP-signature-mangling directive.

pgpsig.description: The `pgpsigurlmangle=...` directive, when present. `None` when absent.

url_pattern.description: The watch file's URL pattern (the first non-comment, non-directive line).
